title: UI风格#161 - Art Nouveau Space (新艺术太空)
description: 创建第161种UI风格：新艺术太空风格 - 宇宙与有机曲线、星光与藤蔓。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planFE.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau Space style When color palette Then features cosmic purple, starlight gold, nebula pink, void black
Given Art Nouveau Space style When typography Then uses elegant cosmic: Cormorant, Playfair Display, or Cinzel
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Cinzel (title/buttons 2.6rem), Playfair Display (body 0.95rem), Cormorant Garamond (tagline/labels italic) - elegant cosmic typography

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau Space style When layout Then organic galaxies, flowering nebulae, stellar vines, cosmic curves
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: organic blob border-radius (30%/70%), cosmic gradient background, drifting star particles animation, vine decorations, stellar pulse animations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau Space style When UI elements Then stellar glow, organic vines, nebula textures, cosmic dust
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: stellar glow text-shadows, gold text-shadow on icons, cosmic dust particle background with drift animation, organic rounded message bubbles, gradient borders

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau Space UI When functional Then includes cosmic chat, stellar agents, orbit stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Stellar Comm Link chat header, 4 stellar agents (STELLAR, NEBULA, COSMOS, GALAXY) with Orbit/Stellar/Cosmic/Galaxy/Flow/Nova/Pulse/Phase stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Nouveau Space UI When copy Then uses celestial organic: 'Stellar', 'Orbit', 'Nebula', 'Cosmic'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'STELLAR. ORBIT. NEBULA.', tagline 'Where cosmic forces intertwine...', button 'LAUNCH', greeting 'Welcome to the cosmic garden...', status 'ACTIVE'/'IDLE', nav 'Orbit'/'Launch'/'Nebula'/'Cosmos'
